articles.summary: MarketWatch: Stocks face their first real test of 2026 with Friday’s pivotal jobs report and possible tariff ruling. Markets are off to a strong start in 2025 — but investors could face their first real test on Friday with the December jobs report and, potentially, a Supreme Court decision on the legality of most of President Trump’s tariffs. Related tickers mentioned: ^GSPC.
